user.t:
You are the graphics/design lead for NeuroForge Bio (pre-product B2B neural-data infrastructure; owner Marius Carlsson). Working copy + briefs are in C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\ (neuroforge-techlead-brief.md; the repo design/ folder has chosen directions "clinical" and "cosmos").

USE THE DESIGN/GRAPHICS PLUGINS the user asked for. First try the Canva MCP tools (mcp__claude_ai_Canva__generate-design, generate-image, create-design, export-design) and/or the Figma MCP tools to actually produce assets. If a plugin tool errors / needs auth / is unavailable, FALL BACK to producing crisp SVG/HTML assets on disk — do not block. Report which path you used.

PRODUCE (grounded, honest — NO fabricated competitor-beating numbers, NO fake photorealistic medical-device demo; this is pre-product research):
1. An investor-deck visual set: a clean logo/wordmark treatment, a title slide, a "how neural decoding works" explanatory diagram (signal in -> model -> control out), the platform architecture diagram (ingest/provenance/registry/SDKs), and an honest "speed" chart template (our measured baseline — leave labeled placeholder until ...\scratchpad\neuroforge-benchmark.md lands; competitor points only from cited sources like NDT 3.9ms arXiv preprint, labeled not-a-head-to-head).
2. Website hero/section imagery consistent with the clinical/cosmos direction.
3. A STORYBOARD (frames + narration script) for a concept explainer of the bidirectional somatosensory-feedback ROADMAP item — explicitly labeled "concept / simulation / future, requires IRB+FDA," NOT a demo of a working device. Do not claim it exists.
Save everything under ...\scratchpad\neuroforge-design\ and write an index + the storyboard to ...\scratchpad\neuroforge-design\README.md. Return a concise summary listing assets produced and which plugin (or fallback) made them.

handback.t:
Design set is done and saved in `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\neuroforge-design\`. Only one asset came from a plugin (the Canva image). Everything else is SVG I built myself, because I judged the Canva design tools and Figma wrong for exact labelling and did not try them. `README.md` in that folder has the asset index and the storyboard table.

**Which path made what**
- **Canva `generate-image`:** worked and produced one asset, an abstract neural-network background (`web-hero-cosmos-canva-bg.jpg`, Canva media id MAHXCZ2e1V8). The file is only about 6 KB, so re-export it from Canva at full size before production use.
- **Not tried:** I did not call Canva `generate-design`, `create-design` or `export-design`, and I did not use Figma. Editable decks would need your Canva or Figma session, and the diagrams needed exact honest labels. Everything else is SVG from `gen.py`, which regenerates all of it with `python gen.py`.
- **Styling:** colours match the repo's clinical and cosmos directions. Fonts fall back to system stacks (IBM Plex or Space Grotesk if installed).
- **Rendering check:** I rendered the architecture slide and the speed chart in Edge and fixed some text overflow in the architecture slide. I did not render the other SVGs after that fix, so only those two were looked at.

**Assets produced**
- **Logo:** `logo-mark.svg`, `logo-wordmark-clinical.svg`, `logo-wordmark-cosmos.svg`.
- **Investor deck (1920x1080):**
  - `deck-01-title.svg`
  - `deck-02-how-decoding-works.svg` (signal in, model, control out, with a closed-loop arc)
  - `deck-03-platform-architecture.svg` (sources, ingest, provenance, registry, SDKs)
  - `deck-04-speed-chart-template.svg`
- **Website:**
  - `web-hero-clinical.svg` (EEG-trace hero)
  - `web-hero-cosmos.svg` (generated point-cloud, labelled illustrative)
  - `web-hero-cosmos-canva-bg.jpg` (the Canva background)
  - `web-section-pipeline-clinical.svg` (Ingest, Clean, Neuro-AI, SDKs)
- **Storyboard:** `storyboard-frame-01.svg` to `storyboard-frame-06.svg`. They cover the open question, today's decoding, the bidirectional loop as a roadmap idea, a simulation-only frame, the IRB and FDA gates, and a close. Every frame carries an amber banner: "CONCEPT / SIMULATION / FUTURE - REQUIRES IRB + FDA - NOT A WORKING DEVICE". Each frame has narration text, and nothing claims a working device.

**Speed chart**
- The NeuroForge bar is a dashed placeholder labelled `[ PENDING ]`, with "height is not data" written on it. It fills in only once `neuroforge-benchmark.md` exists; that file does not exist yet.
- The only competitor point is Neural Data Transformer at 3.9 ms, cited to Ye and Pandarinath, arXiv:2108.01210, as a preprint graded C.
- A "NOT A HEAD-TO-HEAD" panel and a fill-in checklist (median and p95, hardware, bin size, source) sit beside the chart.

**For you to do**
- Get scientific review of the wording in storyboard frame 3, and clinical and legal sign-off, before anything goes external.
